Dear all:

     Any insight on similar error message in part 5, logged at github issues (#22).  Basically, part 5 halted at "Error in if (time_num < 12) time_num = time_num + 24 : missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed"

datadir, outputdir and desiredtz are defined elsewhere.  Any insight is greatly appreciated.

g.shell.GGIR(#=======================================
             mode=c(5),
             datadir=datadir,
             outputdir=outputdir,
             f0=f0, 
             #f1=1
           
             #-------------------------------

             threshold.lig = c(30), threshold.mod = c(100),  threshold.vig = c(400),
             boutcriter = 0.8,      boutcriter.in = 0.9,     boutcriter.lig = 0.8,
             boutcriter.mvpa = 0.8, boutdur.in = c(1,10,30), boutdur.lig = c(1,10),
             boutdur.mvpa = c(1),   timewindow = c("WW"),
             desiredtz = desiredtz
             
           
           
           )
